topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition Behind Backpropagation

sections.title: The Neuron as a Decision-Maker
lecture_lines: Perceptrons process inputs using weighted importance.
Weights define the neuron's decision-making power.
Learning adjusts weights to minimize overall error.
animations: Show incoming signals as pulses moving towards the neuron (#FF0000).
Highlight the threshold level with a horizontal line (#00FF00).

sections.title: Quantifying the Mistake (The Loss Function)
lecture_lines: Loss measures distance between prediction and reality.
Imagine a target representing the correct output.
The goal is to shrink this error distance.
animations: Represent prediction and target as separate dots (#FFFFFF).
Draw a line between prediction and target (#FFFF00).
Show the distance (error) as a shaded rectangle (#FF0000).

sections.title: The Logic of Backpropagation: Blame Assignment
lecture_lines: Backpropagation is the process of apportioning blame.
Errors are passed back from the output layer.
Hidden layers are updated based on their contribution.
animations: Highlight an output error in the final layer (#FF0000).
Animate backward flow of errors towards input layer (#0000FF).

sections.title: Gradient Descent: The Path to Perfection
lecture_lines: Loss functions form a complex, hilly landscape.
Gradients act as a compass pointing downhill.
Descending the slope lowers the error step-by-step.
animations: Visualize a landscape of low and high error regions (#FFFFFF).
Place a marble at a high error starting position (#FF0000).
Animate the marble rolling downwards into a valley (#00FF00).

sections.title: Summary & Continuous Learning
lecture_lines: Forward passes predict while backward passes blame.
Continuous weight updates drive the learning process.
Repetition transforms basic inputs into high intelligence.
animations: Display a checklist of the four core concepts (#FFFFFF).
Highlight each checked item one by one (#00FF00).
Fade out the checklist leaving a glowing neural network (#FFFFFF).
